title.zh: 将三宝颜市 Lamisahan 描笼涯的 Manicahan 国立中学－Lamisahan 附属校从该校分离，改设为名为 Lamisahan 国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Manicahan National High School - Lamisahan Annex in Barangay Lamisahan, Zamboanga City from the Manicahan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as Lamisahan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Manicahan National High School - Lamisahan Annex in Barangay Lamisahan, Zamboanga City from the Manicahan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as Lamisahan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Lamisahan của Trường Trung học Manicahan Quốc gia tại Barangay Lamisahan, Thành phố Zamboanga khỏi Trường Trung học Manicahan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Lamisahan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Lamisahan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Manicahan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Lamisahan เมือง Zamboanga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Manicahan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lamisahan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Lamisahan, Sekolah Menengah Manicahan Nasional di Barangay Lamisahan, Kota Zamboanga dari Sekolah Menengah Manicahan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lamisahan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Lamisahan, Sekolah Menengah Manicahan Kebangsaan di Barangay Lamisahan, Bandar Zamboanga daripada Sekolah Menengah Manicahan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lamisahan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Manicahan National High School - Lamisahan Annex in Barangay Lamisahan, Zamboanga City is hereby separated from the Manicahan National High School and converted it into an independent natonal high school to be known as Lamisahan National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Manicahan National High School - Lamisahan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Lamisahan National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Lamisahan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Manicahan National High School - Lamisahan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within sixty (60) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
